transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom Enterprise Support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hello Alex. This is Maria Rodriguez from Beacon Consulting. I need to set up services for a new branch office we're opening.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Certainly, Ms. Rodriguez. I can definitely assist with that. To access your account, could you please provide your corporate account ID?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, our account ID is CUST-2006.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. I have the Beacon Consulting account pulled up. For security, could you please verify the 6-digit security PIN associated with the account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Of course. The PIN is 9-1-9-5-3-4.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, that's a match. Thank you for verifying your information. So, you're looking to establish service for a new office. That's exciting news.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: It is. We're expanding. We need both internet and our phone system set up.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. We can absolutely get that arranged. First, could you provide me with the full street address for the new location so I can check for serviceability?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, it's 1550 West Arlington Boulevard, Suite 210, in Greenville, North Carolina. The zip code is 27834.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, 1550 West Arlington Boulevard, Suite 210, Greenville. Let me just plug that into our system to see what Cymbal services are available there. This will take about 30 seconds. Do you mind holding for a moment?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that's fine. Go ahead.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience, Ms. Rodriguez. I have great news. That address is fully serviceable with our Cymbal Fiber network. We can offer you high-speed business internet and integrate your voice services seamlessly.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's wonderful to hear. What are our options for internet speed?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Based on your existing enterprise account, I'd recommend our Cymbal Fiber Pro plans. For a small to medium branch office, our most popular plan is the Fiber Pro 500, which provides symmetrical speeds of 500 megabits per second for both download and upload. Would that meet your needs?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: 500 symmetrical... yes, that sounds more than adequate. It'll be a small team, about five to seven employees to start. What is the monthly cost for that plan?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: For our corporate partners, the Fiber Pro 500 plan is priced at $129.99 per month. That includes a static IP address and our advanced security suite.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, $129.99. Is there a contract required?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We do have options. With a 24-month agreement, we can waive the standard $199 professional installation fee.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Waiving the installation fee sounds good. We plan to be there for the long term, so a 24-month agreement is acceptable.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. Now, for the voice services. I see your main office uses our Enterprise SIP Trunking. We can extend that to the new location by adding Cloud VoIP user licenses. This means all your offices will be on one unified phone system.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's exactly what I was hoping for. So we just add licenses for the new employees? How many phones can we have?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Correct. You mentioned five to seven employees. Each employee would need one license. How many would you like to start with?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Let's start with seven to be safe. We can always add more later, I assume?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely. The system is very scalable. You can add or remove licenses with just a phone call. The cost per Cloud VoIP user license is $19.99 per month.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, so seven licenses at $19.99 each. Let me do the math... that's about $140 a month for the phones.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's right. Seven licenses at $19.99 comes to $139.93 per month for the voice component.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: And do we need to purchase specific phones from you, or can we use our own?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a great question. Our system is compatible with a wide range of SIP-compliant IP phones. If you have existing phones, I can check their model numbers for compatibility. Alternatively, we offer the latest Polycom and Yealink models, which we can pre-configure and ship to you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: We have a stock of Polycom VVX 450s at our main office. Would those work?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The Polycom VVX 450s? Yes, absolutely. They are fully compatible and one of our recommended models. You can simply take them to the new office and our technician can help get them connected and provisioned during the install.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Perfect. That saves us a significant cost. So, to recap, we're looking at the Fiber Pro 500 internet for $129.99, and seven VoIP licenses for $139.93. The total is... what, around $270 per month?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your math is spot on. The total monthly recurring charge for the new location would be $269.92, plus any applicable taxes and fees.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: And the installation fee is waived with the 24-month contract.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Correct. A one-time professional installation fee of $199 is waived, so your upfront cost is zero.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: This sounds like the right plan for us. I have the authority to approve this. Let's move forward with the order.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent choice, Ms. Rodriguez. I'll start building the order for you now. Can you just confirm one more time for the record that you are authorizing Cymbal Telecom to add these services to your account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, I, Maria Rodriguez, on behalf of Beacon Consulting, authorize this order.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Let me create the work order. I'm adding the Cymbal Fiber Pro 500 service and seven Cloud VoIP licenses to the new service address at 1550 West Arlington Boulevard. This will just take me a minute or two.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Take your time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, the service order is created in the system. The next step is to schedule the professional installation with one of our field technicians.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay. We're aiming to have the office operational in about three weeks. What does your schedule look like?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me pull up the dispatch calendar for the Greenville area. Three weeks from now... let's see. I am looking at the week of the 16th. Do you have any specific days that work best for you?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Earlier in that week would be ideal. How about Monday the 16th or Tuesday the 17th?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Checking availability for those days... Monday the 16th is fully booked, I'm afraid. However, on Tuesday the 17th, I have two available appointment windows: a morning slot from 8 AM to 12 PM, or an afternoon slot from 1 PM to 5 PM.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: The morning slot on Tuesday the 17th would be perfect. Let's book the 8 AM to 12 PM window.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. I am locking in your appointment for Tuesday, the 17th, between 8 AM and 12 PM. Now, for the installation, our technician will need access to the suite and the building's telecommunications closet. Will someone be on-site to provide access?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, I will be there personally to oversee the setup.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. And can I confirm the best on-site contact number for the technician to call? They typically call about 30 minutes prior to arrival.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, they can reach me on my mobile. The number is 919-555-0182.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, mobile number 919-555-0182. I've added that to the technician's work order notes.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great. What exactly will the technician do? I want to make sure I have everything ready for them.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The technician will run a fiber optic line from the building's utility point to your suite. Inside your suite, they will install a small device called an Optical Network Terminal, or ONT. That's what the main router will plug into. They will then install and configure the Cymbal Telecom provided router.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: And the phones?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Once the internet is active, they will test the connection and can assist with plugging in your Polycom phones to ensure they connect to our network and provision correctly. They will also make sure you can make and receive a test call before they leave.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That sounds very thorough. What about Wi-Fi?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, the router we provide is a dual-band Wi-Fi 6 router. The technician will set up a secure wireless network for you. It will broadcast a default network name, something like 'Cymbal Wi-Fi-2G' and 'Cymbal Wi-Fi-5G', but you can work with the technician to customize the network name and password to whatever you'd like.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, we'll probably name it 'BeaconConsulting-Guest' or something similar. That's good to know.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can set up multiple networks if needed, yes. The technician can walk you through that.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Excellent. This all sounds very straightforward.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We try to make it as smooth as possible. Okay, I have everything finalized on my end. Your order is confirmed. Would you like a confirmation number for your records?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, please.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your order confirmation number is NC-88-1-7-0-4-B. That's NC, as in North Carolina, 881704B.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Got it. NC-881704B. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome. So, just to do a final recap for you: We have placed an order for Cymbal Fiber Pro 500 internet and seven Cloud VoIP licenses for the new address. The total monthly cost will be $269.92 plus tax.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The one-time installation fee has been waived with a 24-month service agreement.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And we have a technician scheduled to arrive at the new office on Tuesday, the 17th, between 8 AM and 12 PM. The on-site contact is you, Maria, and the technician will call your mobile 30 minutes before arrival.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That all sounds perfect. Thank you for being so organized.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's my pleasure. You will also receive an email confirmation of this order and the appointment details within the next hour. It will be sent to the primary email address on file, which I see is maria.rodriguez@beaconconsulting.com. Is that still correct?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's my email. I'll look out for it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. The first bill for this new location will be generated after the services are successfully installed and activated. It will be pro-rated from the date of activation to the end of your billing cycle.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that makes sense. I don't think I have any other questions at this time. This was very efficient.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm glad I could help. Is there anything else at all I can assist you with today, Ms. Rodriguez? Perhaps regarding your main account or any other services?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, one last thing. If we need to reschedule the appointment for any reason, who do I call?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great question. You can call this same Enterprise Support number. Just provide the agent with your order confirmation number, NC-881704B, and they can access the appointment details and help you reschedule.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, good to know. Hopefully we won't need to.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We'll be ready for you on the 17th. We look forward to getting your new office connected.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Me too. Thank you again for your help, Alex.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are most welcome, Ms. Rodriguez. Thank you for choosing Cymbal Telecom for your new location, and thank you for being a valued enterprise partner.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Alright. Have a good day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You too. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Goodbye.
